skills.title: JWT-Secured FastAPI Service
skills.goal: Build a FastAPI service with JWT auth and rate limiting
skills.approach: Short-lived access + refresh tokens; auth middleware; per-IP rate limiter; tests cover token expiry, refresh, and 429 paths. Council passed on clear separation of auth vs business logic.

skills.title: Cross-Reference Investigation
skills.goal: Investigate vendor payments against lobbying disclosures
skills.approach: OpenPlanter entity-resolution across both datasets, then cross-reference for shared directors/addresses; the red-team gates every inferred connection before it ships. Vetted for surfacing non-obvious links without overclaiming.

skills.title: Architecture Decision Recipe
skills.goal: Decide a software architecture (e.g. monolith vs microservices) for a new product
skills.approach: Three independent lenses (product, operations, architecture) + a red-team that tests the load-bearing claim before the verdict. Vetted pattern: prefer the reversible, simpler option and gate complexity behind real triggers.
